_comment: Recorded supersession judge responses per candidate pair (earlier decision id -> later decision id), standing in for Opus 5.5. 'earlier' and 'later' are for reading only. Pairs inside the Held-out Window are asked only when the fixture is built with FIXTURE_WINDOW_END. Pairs already linked explicitly are asked only by `whycode supersession-report`.

decision:4815a0cb327ff91e -> decision:51.earlier: pr:101450: Keep retrying schema change jobs on descriptor validation errors instead of treating them as permanent
decision:4815a0cb327ff91e -> decision:51.later: pr:104500: Treat descriptor validation errors as permanent only once the cluster version is finalized; keep retrying them during an upgrade
decision:4815a0cb327ff91e -> decision:51.label: refines
decision:4815a0cb327ff91e -> decision:51.quote: This treats descriptor validation errors as permanent again once the cluster version is finalized
decision:4815a0cb327ff91e -> decision:51.reason: B keeps retrying validation errors during an upgrade, as A decided, but makes them permanent once the upgrade is finalized.

decision:9b97db3df47e8d28 -> decision:a8.reason: B runs the statement phase inside the user's transaction instead of A's child transaction.
